I implemented `minidb/parser.py` with `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression`. All 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run the rest of the suite, and I didn't need to change the test file.

The parser follows the grammar in the `minidb.types` docstring. A private `_Parser` class does the recursive descent. It raises `SQLSyntaxError` with a short message that includes the offending token, or "end of input".

If the token list doesn't end with an EOF token, the parser adds one rather than failing. The tokenizer always supplies EOF, so this only matters for hand-built token lists.
